text: In the lab, what distinguishes closed-loop (autonomous) prediction from open-loop (teacher-forced) prediction?
choices: Closed-loop retrains W_out at every step; open-loop trains it once
Closed-loop uses a larger reservoir than open-loop
Closed-loop feeds the ESN's own prediction back as the next input; open-loop uses the true value
Closed-loop discards the washout period; open-loop keeps it
explanation: closed_loop_predict warms up the reservoir, then feeds each output y_t back as the next input u_t, running autonomously. Open-loop (esn.predict) uses the true test inputs at every step. Neither retrains W_out at test time; reservoir size and washout are unchanged.
